original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Expose 222 original forward BIT helper queries before the source starts, bind all 111 actual port routes, and verify the complete source endpoint and owned return.
scope_change_reason: The user assigned publication of the saved source interface. It changes the entrance observation contract and does not replace the source H2/K word or claim a complete supplier.
bottleneck_link: A controller can use two independent early Q observations per port without a new native child. Its complete target decoding and ordinary tariff remain open.
stop_rule: Verify the pinned finite source, its route matrices, all input columns and rejection controls. Do not search for a new caller or claim a kappa gain.
evidence: PROOF.md and RESULT.json; exact 222-cut and 286-cut replays, 111 rational port routes, source-pin mutations, and owned-return controls.
author: OpenAI Codex research assistance
ai_assistance: This BIT adaptation, proof, code and packaging have substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. The retained source and the PR5388 entrance method keep their own credits.

open_questions.question: Can a complete controller use the early responses and close every coupled helper output?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Early observations alone do not change the recursive paid-minus-target invoice or the multiplication exponent.
open_questions.first_step: Write one literal caller with all active helper inputs and final targets, then check its full operator endpoint before pricing it.
open_questions.blocked_by: No profitable complete caller has been constructed.

open_questions.question: Can that caller fund the fixed cover routes and ordinary work?
